full_text: REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT Legal Opinion No. 46 s. 2011 JUL 15 2011 Mr. DANIEL A. FALUNAN ZMZ Public Market San Marcelino, Zambales Dear Mr. Falunan: This concerns the Petition which you and several others filed with the Department of Justice but thereafter forwarded to this Department for appropriate action involving the implementation of Ordinance No. 0845-2004 othenavise known as the Revised Market and Slaughterhouse Code of 2004 of San Marcelino, Zambales. A reading of the Petition reveals that, for various reasons, you are assailing the validity of the aforementioned Ordinance. May we note that the Mayor thereat issued Executive Order No. 001-201 1 dated January I l, 201 1 mandating the implementation and execution of said Ordinance. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department refrains from rendering opinion on matters that are presumptively valid acts, such as the duly enacted ordinance in this case, that already enjoy the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer that enacted it (per Memorandum Order No. 2010-02 dated 17 September 2010, supplementing Memorandum Order No. 2010-01 dated 04 March 2010). Hence, we regret to inform you that we cannot act on the Petition. We note that the subject Ordinance sought to be nullified was enacted way back in 2004 and the Sangguiniang Panlalawigan of Zambales did not declare it invalid when it was forwarded to it for review pursuant to the provisions of the LGC of 1991 . Be that as it may, you are hereby advised that though the subject ordinance is presumed valid you can still question its validity by filing a Petition for Declaratory Relief under Rule 63 of the Rules of Court. Very yours, AUST EA. PANADERO Undersecretary cc: hope have enlightened you on the matter. HON. LEILA M. DE LIMA Secretary Department of Justice Padre Faura, Manila
